Gossip topology setup and runtime metrics reporting for gossip, gossvf, and ipecho tiles.

# Purpose
This file defines the `gossip` action for `fdctl`. It builds the runtime topology for the gossip service, sets up the `gossip`, `gossvf`, and `ipecho` tiles, connects them to the network and signing paths, and assigns the configuration values needed by each tile. The [`gossip_cmd_topo`](<#gossip_cmd_topo>) and [`fd_gossip_subtopo`](<#fd_gossip_subtopo>) functions create the topology objects, links, workspaces, and tile inputs and outputs. The `gossip_cmd_perm` function requests the permissions needed to run the configure and run stages for this action.

The file also contains the main command function, [`gossip_cmd_fn`](<#gossip_cmd_fn>), which starts Firedancer, joins workspaces, runs the topology, and then enters a loop that reads and prints live metrics. It includes helper code to format counts, bytes, and percentages, and it aggregates metrics across all `gossvf` tiles instead of using only one tile. The output reports message traffic, CRDS table state, network bandwidth, overrun counts, and per-message drop statistics for pull request, pull response, push, prune, ping, and pong traffic.
